# AFX DEX Developer Documentation

AFX DEX is a decentralized perpetuals exchange with an AI-agent-friendly API surface.

## Primary Docs

- Overview: /api-overview.md
- Quick start: /afx-api/api-overview/quickstart.md
- Python SDK: /afx-api/api-overview/sdk.md
- Signing: /afx-api/api-overview/signing.md
- Exchange API: /afx-api/openapi/exchange.yaml
- Info API: /afx-api/openapi/info.yaml
- WebSocket API: /afx-api/openapi/websocket.yaml

## Machine-Readable Artifacts

- Combined REST OpenAPI: /afx-api/artifacts/openapi.json
- Info OpenAPI: /afx-api/artifacts/openapi-info.json
- Exchange OpenAPI: /afx-api/artifacts/openapi-exchange.json
- WebSocket AsyncAPI: /afx-api/artifacts/asyncapi.json
- Signed action envelope schema: /afx-api/artifacts/schemas/signed-action-envelope.schema.json
- Signed action payload schemas: /afx-api/artifacts/schemas/signed-actions.schema.json
